title: Studies of Pancreatic Islet Mass by Positron Emission Tomography (PET)
brief_summary: This study investigates the hypothesis that differences in beta-cell mass in patients with diabetes and healthy individuals can be monitored by the positron emission tomography (PET) tracer \[11C\]5-hydroxytryptophane.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients with type 1 diabetes
* Adult, healthy controls

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Impaired renal function
study_population: Adult, type 1 diabetic patients Healthy controls
